doc.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Liborio: owner and his ten years there
summary: Liborio and Chateau Madrid were the two first-class Latin cabarets; owner Perez Blanco; he started in 1963 recommended by Miguelito Valdes.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So let's talk about the Liborio. In short you tell me which years you were there, and who was the owner of this place? Apparently it was the place one had to go through.
There were only two, only two first-class cabarets, the Liborio and the Chateau Madrid. Those were the two. And so then they made . . . one would do a season, one year
at the Liborio and the following year at the Chateau Madrid.
Who was the owner of the Liborio?
Cuban, from Pinar del Rio. The province of Pinar del Rio. Perez Blanco.
And how many years, what year was this place open?
Well I was there ten years.

When I entered there it was in ’63. I was accompanying that year . . . my first show there was with Miguelito Valdés. He was who recommended me. It was he who asked that I be brought in to accompany him. That was in 1963. So I was there ten years.
